items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: The interviewer mentions Booker T in the context of Ardent Studios history; the interviewee responds about the studio's history but does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Booker T.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s Robben Ford. We caught Robben. Robben is at the time, and he may still be, was semi-retired. And I know what that means in the music world, it just means you show him enough money and they’ve got time, and they love you like I hope Robben still does, they’ll come by, they’ll swing by. And that’s what he was doing. He was swinging by on his way to Memphis because he was on his way to Italy. He was spending time in Italy at the time. And I made it affordable for myself by putting myself in one of the…

I want to work for you. You just gave me a flash. I did a bit of session work one time in Ardent Studios and the guy there goes — he points to a B3. And he said, “That’s the organ Booker T played “Green Onions” on. I said, “Whoa.”

Yeah. There’s some serious history in that place, just scary. Yeah. I spent most of my time just looking at the walls. They have wonderful pictures of the sessions that were going on in that place on the walls. So yeah. It was one of those things where, again, energy — you just walk around feeling the walls. Get me some of that. You know? Wow. What a place.
